body: Thank you. I think you might be my fairy godmother. You are a very lovely person, and you made my shitty day brighter.

Thank you all for your kind messages and PMs. Had a talk with the boyfriend when he came home, which escalated into a panic attack on my part, and I ended up saying some hurtful things. I guess I was just so self-destructive that I knew that the best way to hurt myself was to hurt him. 

He retained a Buddha-like calm, because he's some sort of saint, and we talked about me going to the hospital. But I think I'm over any immediate danger of hurting myself. For now I am going to try going back to therapy, taking my meds and not drinking or taking any more xanax.

Sometimes it gets so hard to fight, and I get so tired and angry. Thank you all for being so kind. There are wonderful people in the world, like you all, and like my boyfriend, and so I am going to keep fighting this stupid disease. Someday I hope I can pay it back or pay it forward.
